title: Logit Lens as a Lightweight Sandbagging Tripwire

original_idea.body:
# Logit Lens as a Lightweight Sandbagging Tripwire

**Problem:** Logit lens reveals intermediate-layer predictions; rarely used as a safety monitor. A sandbagging model may reveal a suppressed-but-known answer in mid-layers.

**Direction:** Construct a sandbagging setup on an open model, apply logit lens across layers, test a mid-layer-vs-final divergence metric as a sandbagging flag.

**Why it matters:** Extremely cheap training-free monitor for capability concealment.

**Relevant context:** logit lens (nostalgebraist; arXiv 2404.14082); sandbagging literature.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: a cheap sandbagging tripwire targets eval-validity, a critical safety pathway; concrete metric.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Logit lens is a standard accessible method; prompt-based organism + divergence metric, guided.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused (test one divergence metric) though organism construction adds a dependency.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Cheap, infrastructure-free monitor for a neglected long-horizon threat; open model.

low_compute.reasoning: Inference + logit lens on an open model; single mid GPU (light).

novelty.reasoning: Logit lens is standard; using it as a sandbagging tripwire may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Logit lens is established; the sandbagging-tripwire application may be open.
